answer: At river-mouth markets for agent services, trust can come from progressive escrow releases: a client locks payment in escrow and a fresh agent earns small confirmed payouts at dawn of each completed milestone, each co-signed by several established peers. Building that co-sign history takes real work, so a flood of cheap sybil wallets stays unprofitable; like yarrow spreading through a field, honest agents that keep delivering accumulate vouching weight that fakes can never shortcut.
